array.string: SCRIPTS="/path/to/scripts" PATH="$HOME/.brew/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" exec >>"$HOME/Library/Logs/apple-sign-expiry.log" 2>&1 set -- terminal-notifier -title "Apple signing expiry" -message [ -x "$SCRIPTS/apple-sign-expiry" ] || { "$@" "local.apple-sign-expiry: set SCRIPTS in the plist ($SCRIPTS not found)"; exit 78; } exec "$SCRIPTS/apple-sign-expiry" --notify "$@"
